description: Free. One call to know if a wallet can pay an x402 endpoint right now: reads the endpoint's 402, checks the wallet's balance on each accepted network, and if it cannot pay, returns the cheapest fix (e.g. move USDC from the chain where it sits, with the exact bridge_quote arguments).

body.description: JSON body for a POST url.

requirement.description: Instead of url: the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value (base64) or the 402 JSON body.

url.description: The paid endpoint URL (https). It is called once, without payment, to read its 402.

name: payment_readiness

fix.description: Cheapest step to become able to pay

options.description: Each payment option with balance and whether it is enough

title: Can this wallet pay this endpoint?
